purpose: reconcile vendor statement and internal ledger for charge lines using client reference as key and net value within tolerance comparison

classify.both_same: match on key, net value within tolerance
classify.both_different: match on key, net value differs beyond tolerance
classify.only_left: vendor statement has charge not in internal ledger
classify.only_right: internal ledger has charge not in vendor statement

human_confirmations.question: Which field identifies the same record / charge line in both files?

Should Net Value be compared, and if so, how and with what tolerance? Is Tax Band part of the reconciliation rule? Which file is the source of truth for matching? Which fields should appear in the report row? Which fields are context for the report?
human_confirmations.answer: Yes, compare Net Value numerically, within 0.01. No. Tax Band is recorded on the vendor side only; it is not compared and is not part of the rule. Neither — both are peer sources. Report what is missing from either side and differences in the compared field. The match key (Client Ref) and the compared field (Net Value). Charge Period and Settlement State.
